subject: bone:costal-cartilage-of-third-rib-l
claim: Forme de coin aplati et court, peu evocatrice d'un cartilage costal de 3e cote.

sources.name: Wikipedia — Costal cartilage
sources.excerpt: Costal cartilages vary in length, breadth and direction; they increase in length from the first to the seventh, then decrease.

sources.name: IMAIOS e-Anatomy — Costal cartilage
sources.excerpt: The first seven pairs connect with the sternum; the next three articulate with the cartilage above; the last two have pointed free extremities.

reasoning: Le 3e cartilage monte legerement vers le sternum et s'elargit ; la vue de bout peut le faire paraitre court.
recommendation: Verifier sous les 8 angles avant de conclure.
